newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt paper yields seen up at Wed auction.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt paper yields seen up at Wed auction.

text.p: Banks will bid aggressively at Wednesday's auction of Russian GKO discount Treasury bills in an effort to shake up the stable market and push yields up, dealers said on Tuesday. They said banks would also be active at the OFZ interest-bearing bond auction.
ON WEDNESDAY
THE FINANCE MINISTRY OFFERS
*10.00 trln rbls of 728-day OFZ bonds (series 24017)
*8.00 trln rbls of 364-day GKO T-bills (series 21083)
THE FINANCE MINISTRY PAYS/REPAYS
*6.81 trln rbls in maturing 168-day T-bill (series 22073)
*412.60 bln rbls in interest on series 24006 bond
*up to 6.42 trln rbls in early repayment of series 24006 bond
ON TUESDAY
*Average taxed T-bill yield rose to 18.30 pct from 18.25 pct on Monday
*Average yield on OFZ bond with floating coupon dropped to 27.79 pct from 28.11 pct
*Turnover rose to 2.97 trln rbls from 2.66 trln rbls
*Banks transferred 1.15 trln rbls for trading
*Central bank sold 200.00 bln rbls nominal of T-bills

Dealers forecast the average yield on series 21083 T-bills in the 18.32-18.93 percent range. Series 21082 bills, maturing on July 29, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 84.45 to yield 18.77 percent.

Dealers forecast the average price on series 24017 bonds in the 95.98-99.93 percent range. Series 24016 bonds, maturing on July 21, 1999, the closest maturity date to the new issue, closed on Tuesday at 96.89 to yield 24.75 percent.

"There is a possibility of a premium, since there has recently been little money in the trading system and we should not wait for significant fresh funds coming from non-residents," ING Bank dealer Alexander Romashev said.
Dealers said foreign investors owned most of T-bill series 22073, which is to be repaid on Wednesday.

"I think there will be enough demand to keep the yields at market levels or even at a small premium," a Western bank dealer said. "As practice shows, the Finance Ministry seldom sells one-year paper below the market yield level, most often with a small premium."
He said this was because the ministry had to raise a lot of money for early repayment and that this was easier to do through T-bills.
Dealers forecast a slight price rise in OFZ bonds prices in the next few days following the early repayment of the last tax-exampt bond on Wednesday.
The central bank will hold a trading session in series 24011, 24012, 24013, 24014, 24015 and 24016 OFZ bonds after the auctions.
The Finance Ministry also sells government paper during trading, increasing supply.

"Currently, OFZs are undervalued now, following one operator's recent huge sale of paper and the Finance Ministry's sales," one dealer said. "That is why after tomorrow's auction, prices will correct, since the paper bears less risk than GKOs with a similar tenor."
--Anna Smirnova, Moscow Newsroom, +7095 941 8520
